title: ग्यास च्याम्बरको मृत्यु कथामा सांस्कृतिक प्रभुत्व
nepali: आर्जित शक्तिका पृष्ठभूमिमा रही हिटलरले विकास गरेको दमनकारी चरित्रलाई ग्यास च्याम्बरको मृत्यु कथामा अभिव्यक्त गरिएको छ । यहुदीविनाशका नाममा हिटलरले कायम गरेको जातीय प्रभुत्व यस कथाको मुख्य विषय हो । प्रभुत्व हासिल गर्न हिटलरले अपनाएको दमनात्मक शैली परिधीय प्रतिरोधको प्रमुख कारण बन्न पुगेको छ । जातीय प्रभुत्वका पृष्ठाधारमा विकसित वर्गीय तथा लैब्गिक प्रभुत्वको स्वरूप, प्रक्रिया र चरित्र यस कथाका प्रमुख अनुसन्धेय क्षेत्रहरू हुन् । यस अध्ययनमा विश्लेष्य कथामा अभिव्यक्त प्रभुत्वको स्वरूप, प्रक्रिया र चरित्रलाई विश्लेषण तथा मूल्याब्कन गर्ने उद्देश्य लिइएको छ । यस कार्यका लागि उद्देश्यमूलक नमुना छनोट विधिको प्रयोग गरी पुस्तकालयकार्यलाई सामग्री सब्कलनको माध्यम बनाइएको छ । यस अध्ययनमा सांस्कृतिक अध्ययनको सैद्धान्तिक पृष्ठभूमिबाट वर्गीय, जातीय तथा लैब्गिक प्रभुत्व, प्रभुत्व हासिल गर्ने शैली, प्रभुत्व र प्रतिप्रभुत्वका बिचको द्वन्द्व जस्ता प्रभुत्वको स्वरूप र प्रक्रियासम्बद्ध विषयलाई कथाविश्लेषणको आधारका रूपमा प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यसका आधारमा हिटलरको दमनात्मक चरित्रका कारण सिर्जित जातीय प्रभुत्व र त्यसका पृष्ठभूमिमा विकसित वर्गीय तथा लैङ्गिक प्रभुत्वको अवस्था मूल्याङ्कन गरी प्रभुत्वको स्वरूप र चरित्र सार्वजनिक गरिएको छ । यहुदीदमनको विषय हिटलरको शासकीय प्रभुत्व हुँदै परिधीय प्रतिरोध जागृतिको कारण बन्न पुगेको विश्लेषण गरी प्रतिरोधको प्रवृत्ति यसमा मूल्याङ्कन गरिएको छ । यसबाट सत्ता, शक्ति, प्रभुत्व र अहम्का विरुद्धमा प्रतिरोध जागृत भई प्रतिप्रभुत्व निर्माण हुने निचोडमा पुगिएको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा शासकीय दमनका कारण सिर्जित प्रतिरोध नै प्रभुत्वशाली सत्ताको अस्तित्व निस्तेज पार्ने प्रमुख कारण र माध्यम हो भन्ने निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: Against the background of acquired power, the oppressive character developed by Hitler has been expressed in the story 'Gas Chamber Death'. The racial dominance established by Hitler in the name of Jewish extermination is the main subject of this story. The oppressive style adopted by Hitler to gain dominance has become the principal cause of peripheral resistance. The form, process and character of class and gender dominance developed on the basis of racial dominance are the principal areas of inquiry of this story. In this study, the objective of analyzing and evaluating the form, process and character of the dominance expressed in the story under analysis has been taken. For this work, the purposive sampling method has been used and library work has been made the medium of data collection. In this study, from the theoretical background of cultural studies, topics related to the form and process of dominance — such as class, racial and gender dominance, the style of gaining dominance, and the conflict between dominance and counter-dominance — have been used as the basis of story analysis. On this basis, evaluating the state of the racial dominance created by Hitler's oppressive character and the class and gender dominance developed against its background, the form and character of dominance have been made public. The subject of Jewish persecution, having become the cause of the awakening of peripheral resistance through Hitler's governmental dominance, has been analyzed and the tendency of resistance has been evaluated in this. From this, the conclusion has been reached that resistance awakens against power, force, dominance and ego, leading to the formation of counter-dominance. In this study, the conclusion has been drawn that the resistance created by governmental oppression is itself the principal cause and medium for neutralizing the existence of dominant power.

informal_english: Against the background of acquired power, this story 'Gas Chamber Death' expresses the oppressive character Hitler developed. The main subject of the story is the racial dominance Hitler set up in the name of exterminating the Jews. The oppressive style Hitler adopted to gain dominance ended up being the main cause of peripheral resistance. The form, process and character of the class and gender dominance that grew out of racial dominance are the story's main areas of inquiry. In this study, the aim is to analyse and evaluate the form, process and character of the dominance expressed in the story. For this, purposive sampling was used and library work served as the way of collecting material. From a cultural studies angle, topics like class, racial and gender dominance, the style of gaining dominance, and the clash between dominance and counter-dominance were used as the basis for analysing the story. On that basis, the state of the racial dominance created by Hitler's oppressive character and the class and gender dominance that developed in its wake were evaluated, and the form and character of dominance were brought out. The subject of Jewish persecution, having become the cause of awakening peripheral resistance through Hitler's governmental dominance, was analysed and the tendency of resistance was evaluated. The conclusion reached is that resistance awakens against power, force, dominance and ego, leading to counter-dominance. The study concludes that the resistance born of governmental oppression is itself the main cause and medium for neutralising the existence of dominant power.
